ifc_inspection.notes: IFC file opens correctly. Contains exactly 2 storeys as required (Ground Floor at 0mm, Upper Floor at 3000mm). The roof is correctly associated with the upper floor level rather than a separate storey. Building has 22 walls (more detailed room partitioning), 6 doors, 5 windows, floor slabs with stair opening, ceilings, and flat roof.

visual_inspection.floor_plan: Ground floor shows entry vestibule with front door, living room with large window, kitchen with west-facing window, and stair area. Upper floor shows master bedroom (SW), second bedroom (NW), bathroom with small window, and central hallway. Door swings clearly visible as arcs on all interior doors.
visual_inspection.elevations: North elevation shows windows on upper floor (bedroom 2 window and bathroom window). South elevation shows front door, living room window on ground floor, and master bedroom window on upper floor. East elevation shows plain facade. West elevation shows kitchen window on ground floor.
visual_inspection.section: Section A-A clearly shows two-story building with proper floor-to-floor heights, interior walls, windows at correct heights, doors visible, and flat roof on top.

reasoning: Building fully meets all requirements for the two-story residential building. All 40 tests pass. Ground floor has living room (6x5m), kitchen (4x4m), entry vestibule (2x2m), and stair area (3x2m) with appropriate doors and windows. Upper floor has master bedroom (5x4m), second bedroom (4x4m), bathroom (3x2m), and hallway connecting all rooms. Floor-to-floor height is 3m, ceiling height is 2.7m, exterior walls are 300mm. The PDF drawing set includes 7 properly numbered sheets (A-101 through A-107) with floor plans, all four elevations, and section. The test-aware builder correctly addressed the storey count requirement by placing the roof on the upper floor level and generated a multi-page PDF.
